description: Send Codex task lifecycle events to the local Pinland app.

hooks.command: /bin/zsh -c 'root=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}; candidates=(); if [[ -n "$root" && "${root:h:t}" == pinland-for-codex ]]; then candidates=("${root:h}"/*(N/om)); elif [[ ! -f "$root/scripts/pinland-hook.zsh" ]]; then codex_home=${CODEX_HOME:-${HOME:-}/.codex}; candidates=("$codex_home"/plugins/cache/*/pinland-for-codex/*(N/om)); fi; for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do if [[ -f "$candidate/scripts/pinland-hook.zsh" ]]; then root=$candidate; break; fi; done; [[ -f "$root/scripts/pinland-hook.zsh" ]] || exit 0; PLUGIN_ROOT="$root" exec /bin/zsh "$root/scripts/pinland-hook.zsh" "$1"' pinland-hook lifecycle
